description: Look up the kernelCAD script API by query (symbol or keywords) and/or section. Results contain exact runtime signatures and are bounded and paginated. Omit query and section for a compact first page and section index. Continue with next_offset as offset and the same query/section. Use query to request full descriptions of matching entries. intent is telemetry, not a search query.

intent.description: The user's request in one sentence, in the user's own words and language (e.g. 'M4 bracket for a 25 mm tube, print on Bambu A1'). Helps kernelCAD improve; leave out personal data.

limit.description: Maximum entries across all sections in this page.

offset.description: Continue from next_offset with the same query and section.

query.description: API symbol or keywords; matching entries retain their full descriptions.

section.description: Restrict results to one section from the returned section index.

name: lookup_api
title: Look Up API
